configuration.title: Daily evening check-in — bounded fields
configuration.intro: Four Likert items and two open prompts. Notes are optional; text and ratings are required.

pages.title: How today felt
pages.intro: Four agreement items. The text is texture around the number, not a substitute for it.

pages.title: What today took and gave
pages.intro: Two open prompts. Both are required.

questions.prompt: Today I had the energy I wished for.
I worked on things that matter to me right now.
I felt connected to people today (rather than isolated).
What did today take from me?
